verdict.rationale: Poly documents first-party connectors that let external LLMs and AI tools reach its notes and files. It runs a hosted MCP server with OAuth (mcp.poly.app/mcp), and a runtime probe confirmed the server is live and speaks the MCP OAuth flow. It also ships an official Claude Code plugin, a poly-cli agent skill, and documented integrations for ChatGPT, Codex, Gemini and MCP-compatible IDEs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the integrations working end-to-end beyond the 401 auth probe, and evidence of a broader third-party plugin ecosystem beyond the first-party connectors.
